text:
maya: FYI customer AcmePhoto getting intermittent 401s from mobile SDK after we swapped their API key this morning. Ticket #14567. ~30% requests failing, started ~09:15 UTC.
sara: Thanks. Ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tkt/14567 — they've attached repro app log and curl.
ops-bot: rotation-service: completed key swap for tenant=acmephoto at 2024-12-01T09:12:34Z (new secret: vault://secret/data/acmephoto/apikey-v3)
jin: can you paste the failing curl + response body (no keys) and confirm whether they use our mobile SDK or raw requests?
maya: sample (redacted):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid api key"}
```
They use our mobile SDK v1.2.3 (wrapped calls).
ari: quick triage checklist: vault secret path ok? kube secret updated? edge auth cache invalidation? any sidecars left on old env var names?
jin: note — last quarter we changed Helm chart to store secret under `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var but older rotations/agents sometimes write `api_key` or `api-key`. If kube secret has wrong key name the sidecar env might be empty and fall back to previous value or blank -> 401. Can you `kubectl get secret -n acmephoto acmephoto-apikey -o yaml`?
maya: ran it, output shows:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: acmephoto-apikey
data:
  api-key: YmFzZTY0LWV4YW1wbGUt
  old_key: YmFzZTY0LW9sZA==
```
No `REDWOOD_API_KEY` key present.
jin: bingo. Rotation created a new vault secret path but the rotation hook populates legacy key name. Our runtime looks for `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Some pods picked up new secret via env reload and got blank value -> 401s. Fix: create `REDWOOD_API_KEY` entry with base64-decoded value from `api-key` and restart pods gradually.
ari: Also check edge cache: `edge-auth-cache:tenant=acmephoto` show TTL and recent invalidation. If some edge nodes still had mapping to old key, they could accept previous tokens; inconsistent state causes partial failures.
maya: I patched secret by adding REDWOOD_API_KEY (base64 of same value) and restarted canary pods. Customer says errors dropped to 0. Rolling full restart now.
sara: Customer confirms 200s across devices. Thanks team :tada:
jin: Follow-ups: add validation to rotation pipeline to ensure both legacy and new key names populated, or better, standardize on one key and migration job. I'll open a PR.
ari: I'll add an alert to check rotation->kube secret sync, and add post-rotation smoke test to automation.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: opened issue RN-945: rotation-k8s-keyname-mismatch - assigned to jin
maya: marking support ticket resolved. Thanks all :heart:
